description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Cancel a booking

Cancels a booking in the calendar of the integration. The optional `reason` is handed to the calendar provider, which may show it to the attendee.

body.description: Optional `reason`, at most 500 characters. An empty object or no body cancels without a reason.

bookingId.description: The `id` of the booking as GET /integrations/bookings returns it.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
